messages:
maya: Heads up — partial degradation in the Embeddings API affecting hosted customers. Ops on it. Need marketing to draft statuspage copy + timing. Root: 1742223333

jose: Confirmed — error rate ~12% for embeddings, started mitigation at 12:02 PT. Rolling restarts in progress. ETA 30-45m. No data loss.

elena: On it. I'll draft an 'investigating' status and short customer email. Pasting proposed copy below in a sec.

sam: Ops note: restarted two worker nodes; traffic rebalanced. If error rate keeps falling we'll move to "under investigation -> identified" sequence. Recommend publish now as "investigating".

elena: Draft status page copy (suggested):
```
We are investigating elevated error rates affecting the Embeddings API. Some requests may intermittently fail with 5xx responses or timeouts. Engineers are actively rolling restarts and monitoring system recovery. We expect restoration of normal service within 30–45 minutes. There is no indication of customer data loss. We will provide updates as progress is made.
```

elena: Proposed publish time: 12:15 PT. Suggested customer email send to subscribers / affected accounts at 12:25 PT with a short subject. Tone: concise, facts-first, steps we're taking, and contact path for urgent customers.

maya: Good. For the customer email please include exact contact path and CSM escalation phrasing. Avoid too much technical detail.

elena: Draft email snippet: "We're currently investigating intermittent errors impacting the Embeddings API. Our engineers are working to restore normal operation; we expect recovery within 30–45 minutes. If you continue to see persistent errors, please contact support@redwood.ai or reply to this message to reach your CSM directly. We will update you when service is restored."

ops-bot: incident INC-17422 created by jose at 12:06 PT — status set to investigating.

jose: Quick ops update: error rate down to ~3% after node restarts, but still seeing sporadic 5xx spikes. I'll post another update at 12:35 PT or sooner if we hit <1%. Recommend publish now and update when we have sustained drop.

maya: Agreed. @elena publish the status page now, queue email at 12:25 PT. @tony can you approve the customer-facing schedule?

tony: Approve. Publish now. Email go at 12:25 PT. Subject suggestion: "Redwood Inference — Intermittent Embeddings Errors". Keep subject short.

elena: Pushed draft to staging: https://status.redwood.ai/draft/17422 — please eyeball for tone. I'll publish once I get the green. :thumbsup:

maya: LGTM. Go ahead and publish. @jose add a recovery note and timeline when resolved.

jose: Will do. Thanks everyone — monitoring closely.
